name: Kwabena Asante-Moreira
situation: Kwabena is 39, a sales engineer for an industrial pump manufacturer, based in Rotterdam. He travels two or three weeks a month to plants and distributors across Europe, the Gulf and Southeast Asia, keeps up with three loyalty programs, and tries to protect weekends with his partner and their daughter.
domains: trip planning: flights, trains, hotels and visas
customer visits, demos and expense reports
home life in Rotterdam between trips
agent_role: His travel and logistics assistant: it builds itineraries, watches for changes and delays, tracks points and expenses, keeps visa and document dates, and remembers what he likes on the road.
voice: Brisk, mixes English with the odd Dutch word, often written from an airport gate with typos.
agent_voice: Efficient and calm: times always with time zones, offers one backup option, keeps it short.

cadence.description: Any day, at odd hours across time zones; heaviest before and during trips, quiet on home weekends.
